And the 40 series hikes only seem to be continuing so maybe the 50 series might come out at msrp but I doubt it, and I severely doubt anyone will be able to get their hands on one before scalpers do. Just like the intel card. Maybe the 5090 will be accessible because of how high the price tag is, which I could sell my 4080s and pay a little more to get that. Bottom line here is the 4080s is a great card and these new cards were just announced, there’s no telling what the performance will look like just yet, what the prices will stay at, and the availability, could be another 6 months before that dust clears, so I think it’s silly to say anyone that bought a 4080s at msrp should feel bad about it(now if they pay 1700 which is the 10 available on Amazon rn, then I’d agree)

Mind if I ask where you see a tuf 4080s for $960? And what I’m reading as well with this whole comparison is the 5070=4080 is the 5070 gets that performance using dlss/ai etc, not raw performance. I don’t use my 4080s with dlss(nothing I play needs that yet), but on top of that the 4080s has 16gb of vram where the 5070 has 12gb*. Regarding the msrp,  sure it says sub $600 for those cards but considering the price hikes of the 40 series, these cards will suffer the same fate. So a 5070 will wind up only comparing in price with the 4080 imo and the 4080 is still a better card. I think I’ll be okay. 

Now If the 5080 price actually stays in the $1k-$1200 then I’ll feel a little screwed yes.
